title: Global Multi-Tenant Cloud-Native SaaS Platform
subtitle: Multi-region Kubernetes mesh, Envoy sidecar routing, CockroachDB geo-distributed SQL, and automated tenant isolation.

overview.summary: A cloud-native, geo-distributed multi-tenant SaaS architecture running across AWS and GCP Kubernetes clusters with database-level tenant isolation, automated failover, and global low-latency edge routing.
overview.problemStatement: Global enterprise customers demand data residency compliance (GDPR/APPI), sub-50ms regional latencies, and total isolation from 'noisy neighbors' while minimizing per-tenant infrastructure overhead.
corePrinciples: Cell-based multitenancy architecture with shared control plane and isolated data cells
Geo-partitioned CockroachDB SQL cluster pinning regional customer data to local jurisdiction
Envoy service mesh enforcing mutual TLS, canary routing, and circuit breaking
OpenTelemetry distributed tracing for end-to-end performance observability

data.label: Cloudflare Edge & WAF
data.subtitle: Anycast DNS & DDoS Shield
data.description: 300+ PoPs handling TLS termination, Web Application Firewall filtering, bot detection, and edge asset caching.

data.label: Ingress Controller & Envoy
data.subtitle: Tenant Dynamic Router
data.description: Dynamic Envoy ingress inspecting subdomain & JWT claims to route traffic to the tenant's dedicated compute cell.

data.label: Identity & RBAC Engine
data.subtitle: OIDC / SAML & Session Store
data.description: Centralized authentication verifying enterprise SSO (Okta, Azure AD), generating cryptographically signed session tokens and tenant claims.

specs.failoverStrategy: Replicated session cache with stateless token fallback

data.label: Tenant Application Cells
data.subtitle: Microservices Cluster (Go/Rust)
data.description: Horizontally autoscaled application pods partitioned into isolated tenant tiers (Enterprise tier gets dedicated pod pools).

data.label: CockroachDB Geo Cluster
data.subtitle: Distributed Relational SQL
data.description: Multi-region distributed SQL database with row-level geo-partitioning, serializable transactions, and automatic range repair.

specs.p99Latency: 5.5 ms local read / 28 ms cross-region commit

data.label: Async Worker & Event Bus
data.subtitle: NATS JetStream & Temporal
data.description: Ultra-lightweight high-throughput message streaming engine coordinating background exports, billing webhooks, and email dispatches.

data.label: Observability & Audit Mesh
data.subtitle: Prometheus, Tempo & ClickHouse
data.description: Unified telemetry backend capturing metrics, distributed trace spans, and immutable customer audit trails for compliance.

specs.failoverStrategy: Buffered local disk spooling during network partition

data.description: Origin TLS connection authenticated with Cloudflare Origin CA.
Fast local JWT introspect and scope verification.
Direct pod-to-pod routing within tenant isolation namespace.
Local regional leaseholder queries with strict row-level security.
Dispatches background tasks without delaying client HTTP responses.
Streams query execution metadata and security audit trails.
Application latency, error budgets, and tenant usage metrics.

simulationFlow.title: Client Requests Organization Dashboard
simulationFlow.description: Customer in Frankfurt connects to acme.saasplatform.com. Cloudflare edge intercepts traffic and applies DDoS inspection.

simulationFlow.title: Envoy Ingress Authenticates Tenant Claims
simulationFlow.description: Envoy queries the Auth Service to decrypt customer JWT, extract tenant organization ID, and assert permission policies.

simulationFlow.title: Envoy Routes to European Compute Cell
simulationFlow.description: Based on tenant tenancy policy, request is routed via Istio mTLS to the dedicated EU Kubernetes microservice pod cluster.

simulationFlow.title: Geo-Partitioned SQL Read from CockroachDB
simulationFlow.description: Core service reads customer records from CockroachDB. The local Frankfurt leaseholder satisfies the read locally with zero transatlantic latency.

simulationFlow.title: Asynchronous Usage Metering & Audit Push
simulationFlow.description: Service publishes usage metrics to NATS JetStream for billing aggregation and emits distributed tracing spans to Telemetry mesh.

tradeoffs.decision: Geo-Partitioned CockroachDB vs Separate Regional PostgreSQL DBs
pros: Enforces regional data residency laws automatically at table schema level
Allows single unified operational cluster without complex manual cross-region replication scripts
Zero downtime rolling upgrades and automatic node rebalancing
cons: Cross-region write transactions incur WAN consensus latency (~60-120ms)
Higher memory and CPU footprint per node
rejectedAlternatives: Individual isolated Postgres instances with custom Kafka CDC sync

securityAndCompliance.implementation: CockroachDB REGIONAL BY ROW tables pinning EU user rows strictly to EU availability zones.
Kubernetes NetworkPolicies and Cilium eBPF rules blocking cross-namespace pod communication.
